reason: I do magic for money, so a phone mind-reading trick in Hebrew that works offline is actually a tool for my birthday and event gigs. I'd try the free tricks first, and if one of them fools me it pays for itself in one show.
objection: 99 ₪ feels steep for an app, and installing from a browser and putting my card on some website instead of the App Store makes me wonder if it's legit and if it will keep working after the next phone update.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks look clunky or the reveal is obvious to a spectator, I'm out.
